newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia June house material prices rise 0.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Australia June house material prices rise 0.1 pct.

text.p: Prices for Australian house building materials rose 0.1 percent in June from the previous month and were 1.4 percent higher than a year earlier, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Tuesday.
Other building materials prices increased 0.2 percent in the month and were 1.2 percent higher than a year earlier, the bureau said.

The house materials index has increased every month since September 1996. "An increase in prices for plastic pipes and fittings was the main contributor to the small rise in the index (in June)," the bureau said. "This was offset slightly by a decrease in prices for cupboards and fittings."

Higher prices for plastic pipes and fittings was also the main factor fuelling the increase in the non-house materials index, the bureau said. The non-housing materials index has been rising steadily since October 1996.
